title: 液化地盤評估與改善
summary: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「飽和土有效應力」與「循環應力需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress in saturated soil" and "Cyclic stress demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「飽和土有效應力」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress in saturated soil” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「飽和土有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history. At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress in saturated soil” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「飽和土有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress in saturated soil”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 飽和土有效應力
knowledge.text: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。
knowledge.textEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「液化地盤評估與改善」的「飽和土有效應力：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Effective stress in saturated soil: mechanism and system paths” in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「飽和土有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress in saturated soil" is correct?
options: 只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。
只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure.
A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「飽和土有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress in saturated soil” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「飽和土有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress in saturated soil", which statement holds?
options: 只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
optionsEn: A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「飽和土有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress in saturated soil” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.

quiz.question: 要驗證「飽和土有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress in saturated soil"?
options: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「飽和土有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress in saturated soil” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
knowledge.textEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「飽和土有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections.
A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 循環應力需求：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 簡化循環應力比把地表加速度、應力比與深度折減整合，用於相容方法內的觸發分析。它不是完整時域土體反應，複雜場址與重要構造可能需要更深入分析。假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環應力需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 循環應力需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cyclic stress demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環應力需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
